The '''scorpion''' is a monster found on [[Uncharted Isles]]. It is considered a common resource. Like other combat resources on [[Uncharted Isles]], they can drop a small amount of [[chimes]] when they are defeated. They will always be found near a pile of [[Debris (Uncharted Isles)|debris]] in the form of a smashed barrel, which acts as their spawn point.

Attacking the scorpions will scale their [[life points]] and combative abilities to the player's own combat level.
